title: Got a bit carried away making games for my daughter...
author: ScaleInfamous1847
selftext:
So, a few months ago I decided to have a go at making some mobile games for my daughter. Mainly because so many of the games she enjoys are absolutely riddled with ads, in-app purchases and all that rubbish.

The idea was just to make some nice little games without any of that. Something fun, with things to collect, unlock, scores to beat, etc.

Anyway, I've got a bit carried away and there are now 12 of them!

I've been using Claude for the coding, ChatGPT for the artwork and ElevenLabs for the audio. It's been a massive learning curve but I've genuinely loved doing it. Everything's bundled into one little app called SETT, although the games can all be played and installed separately too.

My daughter and her mates have been playing them, and seem to be enjoying themselves, which was really the whole point in the first place.

I'd love to get a few more people having a go and telling me what they think. I'm under no illusions that they're perfect, and I'm sure there's loads I could improve. I'm just enjoying tinkering and trying to make them as good as I can so if anyone fancies a play, I'd really appreciate some honest feedback!
